title: Only 11% Of Adults Can Pass This Train Driver Entrance Exam
summary: Ten questions test rail safety, observation, mechanical reasoning and clear communication.

landing.intro: The first signals seem easy. Then the exam moves into braking distance, hazards and railway judgment.

about.body:
This ten-question entertainment challenge uses broad safety and reasoning principles that travel across Tier 1 English-speaking railway systems. It avoids country-specific signal aspects, operating rules and job titles while testing observation, communication, braking awareness and safety-first judgment.

Choose one answer for each question. Correctness stays hidden until the final reveal, where the complete answer review is available to unlock.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Answer ten increasingly difficult train-driver aptitude questions.
Choose the safest or best-supported response.
Reveal your score, then unlock every answer you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not an official railway recruitment, medical, safety or employment assessment. Signals, rules and procedures vary by operator and jurisdiction.

train-q1.question: A train is moving toward an unexpected obstruction. What is the driver’s first priority?
answers: Apply the appropriate braking response and follow emergency procedure
Wait for another train to report it

train-q2.question: Why is sustained attention essential during a long, uneventful section of track?
answers: The train becomes lighter over time
A critical signal or hazard can appear after a long quiet period
The route automatically becomes less safe at noon

train-q3.question: If speed increases, what generally happens to stopping distance when other conditions stay similar?

train-q4.question: Which radio message is most useful when reporting a track hazard?
answers: A long guess about its cause
A vague warning with no location
A personal opinion about the timetable
A concise factual description with the exact location and direction of travel

train-q5.question: Why must a driver avoid relying on memory alone for a safety-critical instruction?
answers: It should be confirmed and followed through the approved process
Memory becomes perfect at higher speed

train-q6.question: A warning indicator changes briefly and then returns to normal. What is the safest interpretation?
answers: Treat it as relevant, monitor it and report it through the proper process
Reset every system immediately without checking

train-q7.question: Wheel slip is most likely when traction between wheel and rail is what?

train-q8.question: You are unsure whether a safety-critical instruction was heard correctly. What should you do?
answers: Repeat it back and obtain confirmation

train-q9.question: Why are fatigue controls important in train driving?
answers: Fatigue can reduce attention, reaction and decision quality
Only passengers are affected by long hours

train-q10.question: Two route displays conflict immediately before departure. What is the safest response?
answers: Do not proceed until the discrepancy is resolved through the proper process
Choose the route that looks shorter
